decided: When a folder of decision records, or the folder holding the change account the review reads, exists but cannot be opened, orbit now stops with an error naming that folder wherever it works out which records still need a reader, instead of treating the folder as empty. This holds for the decision-record folder under every sign-off setting, not only when the user signs off on each change.
alternatives: Fix only the account folder, leaving the decision-record folder read as empty when it cannot be opened, as before.
Keep reading an unopenable folder as empty and leave the records unread without saying so.
why: A folder read as empty hides records nobody has checked, and the user signs off believing nothing is unread; the review that found it asked for a loud failure, and one rule in the one place that picks unread records covers both folders. The user agreed to the walk as previewed, which named both folders.

relies_on.title: The reading step's brief is rendered by orbit

detail: assertListable in selectUnreadRecords (src/core/decision-records.ts); selectionAtGate in emit-composition.ts wraps it as a write-gate refusal for the review owed list and the archive count; selectedOrFail in program-brief.ts.
